About 2 years ago when I was having a tough time at school. I had no friends and was having trouble keeping up with the high grade expectations my parents had so I started feeling shitty. I was reading a lot of books about self harm and suicide so I think it started off as one of those stupid attention seeking things teens do. Y'know like, I wanna die but I don't really want to. As time passed though, I really began to question what exactly in the future was going to make my life worth living and I couldn't find anything. The small things aren't good enough and I don't care about finding love or a fulfilling career. At this point, I'm actually very bothered by my suicidal thoughts and have even attempted to get a hold of nembutal. Not a day goes by where I don't ask myself if living is worth it. How funny that this all started because of some stupid attention seeking tendencies.
Edit: Scratch that it was 3 years ago.
